title: S-parameters
text: Model S-parameter network, {Data source} sets Data source Data; {Data file} sets the name of network parameter data file, {Network-parameter object} sets the network parameter objects as data source, {Network parameter type}, {Network-parameters} sets the network parameter values, {Frequency (dB)} sets the frequency of network parameters, {Reference Impedance(Ohm)} sets the reference impedance of network parameters, {Use rational object} sets the rational object as data source, {Residues}, {Poles} sets the residues in order of rational model, {Direct feedthrough}, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise waves, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Modeling options} sets the model S-parameters Time, {Fitting options} sets the rational fit fitting options Fit, {Relative error desired (dB)} sets the relative error acceptable for the rational, {Maximum number of poles}, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} sets the automatically calculate impulse response, {Impulse response duration}, {Use only S-parameter magnitude with appropriate delay}, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Extracted from data, {Frequency data}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Parameter 1} sets the type of S-Parameters, {Parameter 2} sets the type of S-Parameters to plot, {Format1} plots format Magnitude, {Format2} plots format Magnitude, {Y-axis scale}, {X-axis scale} and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.
